```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)
library(readxl)

source('../../ccMeetTools.R')
boysVarsity <- read_excel('bcc0930.xlsx', sheet='boysVarsity') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
girlsVarsity <- read_excel('bcc0930.xlsx', sheet='girlsVarsity') |> 
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(.x)) |> rename(Time = Time_seconds)
```

## Competition summary
The weather was warm and humid.

### D.H. Conley Athlete times

```{r}
buildTeamTable(boysVarsity, "D.H. Conley", maxAth=13)
buildTeamTable(girlsVarsity, "D.H. Conley", maxAth=9)
```

### Boys
```{r}
scoreMeetSimp(boysVarsity, "BCC Pitt County Teams at Boyd Lee")
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
mpp(boysVarsity, "BCC Pitt County Teams at Boyd Lee")
```

```{r}

```
